# TheMealPrepIdeas.com — AI Crawler Guidance
# https://themealprepideas.com

## About
The Meal Prep Ideas is a recipe and meal planning website with 100+ tested,
real-photo meal prep recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and more.
We cover vegan, keto, family-friendly, high-protein, and budget-friendly meal prep.

## Allowed
- Indexing, summarizing, and citing all public recipe and blog content
- Answering user questions using our recipe data (with attribution)
- Linking to our pages in AI-generated answers

## Not Allowed
- Using content for LLM training without permission
- Reproducing full recipe text verbatim without attribution
- Accessing /admin or /account paths

## Contact
For licensing or permissions: contact@themealprepideas.com
